title: 权限不是对象属性，而是一次关系
coreProposition: Permission exists in a currently valid relation among actor, action, destination and circumstances, not in an isolated object's permanent badge.
articleSynopsis: The weekly synthesis examines fifteen articles about identity, approvals, recovery and evidence. Stored facts supply inputs to a scoped, invalidatable authorization relation; none independently grants execution.
concreteScene: Two regular rectangular housings establish a bounded relation through a matching straight connector.
causalChain: Separate inert surfaces approach; complementary facets align; a bounded illuminated connection forms only at contact.
titlePromise: Make a relationship, rather than possession of a token, visually central.
readerProblem: Mistaking saved identity or approval for current permission.
visibleResult: A transparent local connector bridges only those two endpoints
authorityScale: Authority is the bounded relationship rather than a standalone badge
